title: Podaci u prenosu i u mirovanju
summary: TLS na ELB-u i CloudFrontu, privatan pristup (PrivateLink, VPC endpointi, Client VPN, Verified Access), enkripcija između čvorova (EMR, EKS, SageMaker AI, Nitro), KMS vs CloudHSM i S3 enkripcija, integritet (Object Lock, Vault Lock, code signing), lifecycle i backup sa zaštitom od ransomwarea.
title_en: Data in transit and at rest
summary_en: TLS on ELB and CloudFront, private access (PrivateLink, VPC endpoints, Client VPN, Verified Access), inter-node encryption (EMR, EKS, SageMaker AI, Nitro), KMS vs CloudHSM and S3 encryption, integrity (Object Lock, Vault Lock, code signing), lifecycle, and backup with ransomware protection.
